scanNote:
WORKBOOK 41-BET. Unit 10 'The Price of Fame' — Past Simple.

7a-mashqda 6 ta mashhur odamning surati bor (nomlari kitobda YOZILGAN). Skaner bilan tekshirildi, gaplar bilan mosligi TO'G'RI:
  1 Pele became a football player at the age of 16.
  2 Napoleon lost the battle of Waterloo.
  3 Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.
  4 Tom Cruise starred in 'Top Gun'.
  5 Beethoven composed nine symphonies.
  6 Neil Armstrong walked on the moon.

8, 8b va 9-mashqlar ham tekshirildi — hammasi to'g'ri. 9-mashqning moslashi (1d, 2f, 3a, 4b, 5c, 6e) alohida tekshirildi: har bandda ODAT (Present Simple) va BIR MARTALIK hodisa (Past Simple) qarama-qarshi qo'yilgan.

⚠ TARIXIY ANIQLIK — CHANEL No 5: kitobda atir '1922-yilda taqdim etilgan' deyilgan. Ko'pchilik manbalarda esa 1921-yil ko'rsatiladi (1921-yilda yaratilgan va mijozlarga berilgan, 1922-yilda keng savdoga chiqqan). Ya'ni kitobning sanasi mutlaqo xato emas, lekin odatda 1921 deb aytiladi.

⚠ Qolgan Chanel faktlari TO'G'RI: 1883-yilda Saumur shahrida tug'ilgan, 1913-yilda Deauville'da do'kon ochgan, turmushga chiqmagan, farzandi bo'lmagan, 1971-yilda Parijda vafot etgan.

⚠ SODDALAShTIRISh — EDISON: 'Thomas Edison invented the light bulb' — bu keng tarqalgan soddalashtirish. Aslida lampochka ustida ko'p ixtirochi ishlagan (jumladan ingliz Joseph Swan). Edison uni UZOQ IShLAYDIGAN va SOTUVGA YAROQLI qilgan. Kitob boshlang'ich daraja uchun soddalashtirgan.

sections.title: Grammar — famous people and their achievements
sections.titleUz: Grammatika — mashhur odamlar va ularning yutuqlari

exercises.instructionEn: First, match the people in the pictures to the sentences, then put the verbs in brackets into the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval rasmdagi odamlarni gaplarga moslang, so'ng qavsdagi fe'llarni oddiy o'tgan zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI MASHHUR SHAXS:
  Tom Cruise      — amerikalik aktyor
  Neil Armstrong  — amerikalik astronavt
  Beethoven       — nemis bastakori
  Napoleon        — fransuz imperatori va sarkardasi
  Thomas Edison   — amerikalik ixtirochi
  Pele            — braziliyalik futbolchi

USUL: har bir gapdagi ISH kimga tegishli ekanini toping.
  football player → Pele
  battle          → Napoleon
  light bulb      → Edison
  film            → Tom Cruise
  symphonies      → Beethoven
  the moon        → Neil Armstrong

DIQQAT: bu yerda ega SAVOL SO'ZI emas, ISM —
shuning uchun fe'l to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'tgan shaklda.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a battle      = jang
  a light bulb  = elektr lampochka
  to star in    = bosh rolda o'ynamoq
  a symphony    = simfoniya
  the moon      = oy

items.textEn: 1  ............ (become) a football player at the age of 16.
items.whyUz:
PELE — braziliyalik futbolchi, dunyodagi eng mashhur
futbolchilardan biri.
become → BECAME (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'at the age of 16' = 16 yoshida.

NAPOLEON 1815-yilda Vaterloo jangida yengilgan.
lose → LOST (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'a battle' = jang.
Workbook 37-betdagi 5-mashqda Napoleon bor edi.

TOMAS EDISON — amerikalik ixtirochi (1847-1931).
Elektr lampochka va ko'plab boshqa narsalarni ixtiro qilgan.
invent → invented (to'g'ri fe'l).
'a light bulb' = elektr lampochka.

TOM KRUZ — amerikalik aktyor.
'Top Gun' (1986) — uning mashhur filmlaridan biri.
star → STARRED (undosh IKKILANADI —
Workbook 40-betdagi 5-mashqning 5-bandi).
'star IN a film' — predlog IN.

BETHOVEN — nemis bastakori (1770-1827).
To'qqizta simfoniya yozgan; 9-simfoniyasi eng mashhuri.
compose → composed (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).
40-betdagi 2-mashqda ham Bethoven bor edi.

NIL ARMSTRONG — 1969-yilda Oyga birinchi qadam
qo'ygan amerikalik astronavt.
walk → walked (to'g'ri fe'l).
'ON the moon' — predlog ON; 'the moon' — yagona → THE.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Pele/star in Top Gun?
  SA: DID Pele STAR in Top Gun?
  SB: No, he DIDN'T. Tom Cruise STARRED in Top Gun.

QOLIP:
  SA: DID + ism + ASOSIY fe'l + ...?
  SB: No, he DIDN'T. + to'g'ri ism + O'TGAN fe'l + ... .

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT — BIR DIALOGDA IKKI SHAKL:
  Savolda:  DID Pele STAR    (asosiy shakl)
  Javobda:  Tom Cruise STARRED (o'tgan shakl)

  'Did Pele starred' XATO.

DIQQAT — SAVOLDA 'DID' BOR:
  Bu yerda ega ISM ('Pele') — savol so'zi EMAS.
  Shuning uchun 'did' KERAK.
  40-betdagi 6-mashq bilan SOLISHTIRING:
     'WHO directed E.T.?' — 'who' EGA → 'did' YO'Q
     'DID Pele star ...?'  — 'Pele' ega, savol so'zi emas → 'did' BOR

items.question: Did Pele star in Top Gun?
items.answer: No, he didn't. Tom Cruise starred in Top Gun.
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
Savolda 'STAR' (asosiy shakl), javobda 'STARRED' (o'tgan shakl).

items.question: Did Napoleon compose nine symphonies?
items.answer: No, he didn't. Beethoven composed nine symphonies.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'COMPOSE', javobda 'COMPOSED'.
Napoleon sarkarda edi, bastakor emas.

items.prompt: 3  Neil Armstrong / become a football player at the age of 16?
items.question: Did Neil Armstrong become a football player at the age of 16?
items.answer: No, he didn't. Pele became a football player at the age of 16.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'BECOME' (asosiy shakl), javobda 'BECAME' (o'tgan).
DIQQAT: 'Did he became' XATO.

items.prompt: 4  Thomas Edison / lose the battle of Waterloo?
items.question: Did Thomas Edison lose the battle of Waterloo?
items.answer: No, he didn't. Napoleon lost the battle of Waterloo.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'LOSE', javobda 'LOST'.
Edison ixtirochi edi, sarkarda emas.

items.question: Did Beethoven invent the light bulb?
items.answer: No, he didn't. Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'INVENT', javobda 'INVENTED'.
Bethoven bastakor edi, ixtirochi emas.

items.prompt: 6  Tom Cruise / walk on the moon?
items.question: Did Tom Cruise walk on the moon?
items.answer: No, he didn't. Neil Armstrong walked on the moon.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'WALK', javobda 'WALKED'.
Tom Kruz aktyor, astronavt emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni oddiy o'tgan zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Coco Chanel WAS BORN in Saumur, in France, in 1883. Her
  career as a designer STARTED in 1913, when she OPENED a
  hat shop in Deauville. She quickly ADDED sweaters, skirts
  and accessories to her collection and soon everyone
  WANTED to buy her clothes. During her career, Chanel also
  DESIGNED jewellery and PRODUCED perfumes such as Chanel
  No 5, which she INTRODUCED in 1922.

  Although Chanel WAS a beautiful woman, she DIDN'T MARRY
  and she DIDN'T HAVE any children. She DIED in Paris, in
  1971.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Koko Shanel 1883-yilda Fransiyaning Somyur shahrida
  tug'ilgan. Uning dizayner sifatidagi faoliyati 1913-yilda,
  Devildagi shlyapa do'konini ochganida boshlangan.
  U tezda kolleksiyasiga sviterlar, yubkalar va aksessuarlar
  qo'shdi va tez orada hamma uning kiyimlarini sotib olishni
  xohladi. Faoliyati davomida Shanel zargarlik buyumlarini
  ham loyihalashtirdi va Chanel No 5 kabi atirlar ishlab
  chiqardi — uni 1922-yilda taqdim etgan.
  Shanel go'zal ayol bo'lsa-da, turmushga chiqmadi va
  farzandi bo'lmadi. U 1971-yilda Parijda vafot etdi.


HAMMA FE'L TO'G'RI (-ED), faqat:
  be born → WAS BORN  (majhul nisbat)
  be      → WAS
  have    → didn't HAVE (inkorda asosiy shakl)

DIQQAT — 'WAS BORN':
  'be born' — MAJHUL nisbat.
  'Coco Chanel BORN in 1883' XATO.

DIQQAT — INKOR SHAKLLARI (10 va 11-bandlar):
  didn't MARRY  ✓   didn't MARRIED  ✗
  didn't HAVE   ✓   didn't HAD      ✗

DIQQAT — 'ALTHOUGH':
  'ALTHOUGH Chanel was beautiful, she didn't marry.'
  = Shanel go'zal bo'lsa-da, turmushga chiqmadi.
  'although' = ...bo'lsa-da (qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi,
  'but' ga o'xshash, lekin gap BOSHIDA turadi).

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a career     = faoliyat, kasb yo'li
  a designer   = dizayner
  a hat shop   = shlyapa do'koni
  a sweater    = sviter
  a skirt      = yubka
  accessories  = aksessuarlar
  a collection = kolleksiya
  to design    = loyihalashtirmoq
  jewellery    = zargarlik buyumlari
  a perfume    = atir
  to introduce = taqdim etmoq, tanishtirmoq
  although     = ...bo'lsa-da

KOKO ShANEL HAQIDA:
  Fransuz modelyeri. Ayollar modasini o'zgartirgan —
  qulay, sodda kiyimlarni ommalashtirgan.
  'Chanel No 5' — dunyodagi eng mashhur atirlardan biri.

items.textEn: 1  Coco Chanel ............ (be/born) in Saumur, in France, in 1883.
items.whyUz:
'be born' = tug'ilmoq — MAJHUL nisbat.
'Coco Chanel' BIRLIK → WAS + born.
'Coco Chanel born' XATO.

items.textEn: 2  Her career as a designer ............ (start) in 1913 ...
items.whyUz:
start → started (to'g'ri fe'l).
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').
'a career AS a designer' = dizayner sifatidagi faoliyat —
'as' shart.

items.textEn: 3  ... when she ............ (open) a hat shop in Deauville.
items.whyUz:
open → opened.
DIQQAT: urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda (O-pen) →
'n' IKKILANMAYDI.
'a hat shop' = shlyapa do'koni.

items.textEn: 4  She quickly ............ (add) sweaters, skirts and accessories to her collection ...
items.whyUz:
add → added.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 'd').
'add something TO something' — predlog TO.

items.textEn: 5  ... and soon everyone ............ (want) to buy her clothes.
items.whyUz:
want → wanted.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').
'want TO + fe'l' = ...qilishni xohlamoq.
DIQQAT: 'everyone' grammatik jihatdan BIRLIK.

items.textEn: 6  During her career, Chanel also ............ (design) jewellery ...
items.whyUz:
design → designed.
O'qilishi /dɪˈzaɪnd/ — 'g' O'QILMAYDI.
'jewellery' = zargarlik buyumlari (sanalmaydigan).

items.textEn: 7  ... and ............ (produce) perfumes such as Chanel No 5 ...
items.whyUz:
produce → produced.
40-betdagi 5-mashqning 14-bandida ham bor edi.
'such as' = ...kabi, masalan.

introduce → introduced.
'to introduce' = taqdim etmoq, bozorga chiqarmoq.
'which' — narsa haqida ergash gap boshlaydi.

be → WAS (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'Chanel' BIRLIK → was.
'although' = ...bo'lsa-da (qarama-qarshilik).

'(not/marry)' → DIDN'T + MARRY (asosiy shakl).
'didn't married' XATO.
Ma'nosi: go'zal bo'lsa-da, turmushga chiqmadi.

'(not/have)' → DIDN'T + HAVE (asosiy shakl).
'didn't had' XATO.
'ANY children' — inkor gapda 'any'.

die → died (to'g'ri fe'l).
'IN Paris' — shahar → IN;  'IN 1971' — yil → IN.

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the following into full questions, putting the verbs in the past simple, then answer them.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagilarni to'liq savolga aylantiring, fe'llarni oddiy o'tgan zamonga qo'yib, so'ng javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLAR ARALASH BERILGAN — ularni TO'G'RI TARTIBDA
joylashtirib savol tuzasiz.

SAVOL TARTIBI:
  [savol so'zi] + [yordamchi fe'l] + [ega] + [asosiy fe'l] + ...

IKKI XIL YORDAMCHI FE'L:

  'BE' fe'li bilan → WAS/WERE ('did' KERAK EMAS)
     When WAS Coco Chanel BORN?
     WAS Coco Chanel a beautiful woman?

  Boshqa fe'llar bilan → DID + ASOSIY shakl
     When DID her career START?
     What DID she ADD ...?
     When DID Coco Chanel DIE?

Javoblar 8a-matndan olinadi.

items.question: When was Coco Chanel born? — She was born in 1883.
items.whyUz:
'be born' — 'did' KERAK EMAS.
Tartib: When + WAS + ega + BORN?
Javob 8a-matnning 1-bandidan: 1883.

items.question: When did her career start? — It started in 1913.
items.whyUz:
'start' — oddiy fe'l → DID + ASOSIY shakl.
Tartib: When + DID + her career + START?
Javob 8a-matnning 2-bandidan: 1913.
Javobda 'It' = 'her career'.

items.question: What did she quickly add to her collection? — She added sweaters, skirts and accessories.
items.whyUz:
Tartib: What + DID + she + quickly + ADD + to her collection?
'quickly' — ravish, asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN turadi.
DIQQAT: 'to' qo'shiladi — 'add TO her collection'.
Javob 8a-matnning 4-bandidan.

items.question: Was Coco Chanel a beautiful woman? — Yes, she was.
items.whyUz:
'be' fe'li → 'did' KERAK EMAS.
Tartib: WAS + Coco Chanel + a beautiful woman?
'a beautiful woman' — artikl 'a' qo'shiladi.
Javob 8a-matnning 9-bandidan: 'Although Chanel WAS a
beautiful woman' → Yes, she was.

items.question: When did Coco Chanel die? — She died in Paris in 1971.
items.whyUz:
'die' — oddiy fe'l → DID + ASOSIY shakl ('die').
Tartib: When + DID + Coco Chanel + DIE?
Javobda 'DIED' (o'tgan shakl).
Javob 8a-matnning 12-bandidan: 1971.

exercises.explanationUz:
HAR BIR JUFTLIKDA IKKI ZAMON QARShI QO'YILGAN:

  CHAP ustun:  'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat)
  O'NG ustun:  'last ...' / 'yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE

  Ular 'BUT' bilan bog'lanadi:
     odatda shunday qiladi, LEKIN o'sha safar boshqacha.

PRESENT SIMPLE eslatmasi:
  I / you / we / they → fe'l (-S YO'Q)
  he / she / it       → fe'l + S

PAST SIMPLE eslatmasi:
  hamma ega uchun BIR XIL (-ED yoki noto'g'ri shakl)
  inkor: didn't + ASOSIY shakl

items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Jane' 3-shaxs BIRLIK → walk + S = WALKS.

items.textEn: 2  My parents usually ............ (phone) me on Tuesdays, but ...
items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'My parents' KO'PLIK → PHONE (-S YO'Q).
'ON Tuesdays' — takrorlanadigan kunlar → ko'plik.

items.textEn: 3  I usually ............ (go) swimming on Sundays, but ...
items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'I' → GO (-S YO'Q).
'go swimming' — predlogsiz, -ing shakli bilan.

items.textEn: 4  Steve usually ............ (listen) to music in the evenings, but ...
items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Steve' 3-shaxs BIRLIK → listen + S = LISTENS.
'listen TO music' — predlog TO shart.

items.textEn: 5  We usually ............ (visit) my grandparents at Christmas, but ...
items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'We' KO'PLIK → VISIT (-S YO'Q).
'AT Christmas' — bayram bilan AT.

'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'It' 3-shaxs BIRLIK → snow + S = SNOWS.
Ob-havo haqida ega DOIM 'it'.

PAST SIMPLE. play → PLAYED.
'y' oldida UNLI ('a') → Y QOLADI, faqat + ED.

PAST SIMPLE. watch → watched.
'television' oldidan artikl YO'Q.

PAST SIMPLE. visit → visited.
DIQQAT: yo'nalish TESKARI — odatda BIZ borardik,
lekin o'tgan yili ULAR keldi.

PAST SIMPLE. go → WENT.
'BY bus' — transport bilan BY, artikl YO'Q.

'(not/snow)' → DIDN'T + SNOW (asosiy shakl).
'didn't snowed' XATO.

items.textEn: f  last week they ............ (phone) on Wednesday.
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. phone → phoned (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).
'ON Wednesday' — hafta kuni → ON.

exercises.instructionEn: Then match the pairs to make full sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng to'liq gaplar hosil qilish uchun juftlarni moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR BIR JUFTLIK BIR XIL MANTIQDA:
  'Odatda X qilaman, LEKIN o'sha safar Y qildim.'

USUL — MAVZUGA QARANG:
  maktabga borish → transport haqidagi javob
  telefon qilish  → telefon haqidagi javob
  suzish          → boshqa sport haqidagi javob
  musiqa tinglash → boshqa mashg'ulot haqidagi javob
  bobo-buvi       → tashrif haqidagi javob
  qor             → ob-havo haqidagi javob

pairs.left: 1  Jane usually walks to school, but ...
pairs.right: d  yesterday she went by bus.
pairs.leftUz: Jeyn odatda maktabga piyoda boradi, lekin ...
pairs.whyUz:
Ikkalasi ham MAKTABGA BORISh usuli haqida.
piyoda ↔ avtobusda — qarama-qarshilik.
'walk' ↔ 'go by bus'.

pairs.left: 2  My parents usually phone me on Tuesdays, but ...
pairs.right: f  last week they phoned on Wednesday.
pairs.leftUz: Ota-onam odatda seshanba kuni qo'ng'iroq qiladi, lekin ...
pairs.rightUz: o'tgan hafta chorshanba kuni qo'ng'iroq qilishdi.
pairs.whyUz:
Ikkalasi ham TELEFON QILISh kuni haqida.
seshanba ↔ chorshanba — qarama-qarshilik.
'phone' fe'li ikkala qismda ham bor.

pairs.left: 3  I usually go swimming on Sundays, but ...
pairs.right: a  last Sunday, I played tennis.
pairs.leftUz: Men odatda yakshanba kuni suzgani boraman, lekin ...
pairs.whyUz:
Ikkalasi ham YAKShANBA kunidagi sport haqida.
suzish ↔ tennis — qarama-qarshilik.
'on Sundays' ↔ 'last Sunday' — juft ibora.

pairs.left: 4  Steve usually listens to music in the evenings, but ...
pairs.right: b  last night he watched television.
pairs.leftUz: Stiv odatda kechqurunlari musiqa tinglaydi, lekin ...
pairs.whyUz:
Ikkalasi ham KEChQURUNGI mashg'ulot haqida.
musiqa ↔ televizor — qarama-qarshilik.
'in the evenings' ↔ 'last night' — juft ibora.

pairs.left: 5  We usually visit my grandparents at Christmas, but ...
pairs.right: c  last year they visited us.
pairs.leftUz: Biz odatda Rojdestvoda bobom-buvimnikiga boramiz, lekin ...
pairs.whyUz:
Ikkalasi ham TAShRIF haqida.
DIQQAT — YO'NALISh TESKARI:
  odatda BIZ ularnikiga boramiz ('we visit them')
  o'tgan yili ULAR biznikiga keldi ('they visited us')
'visit' fe'li ikkala qismda ham bor.

pairs.left: 6  It usually snows in January, but ...
pairs.right: e  last year it didn't snow.
pairs.whyUz:
Ikkalasi ham QOR haqida.
yog'adi ↔ yog'madi — eng aniq qarama-qarshilik.
'snow' fe'li ikkala qismda ham bor.

wordFormation.introUz: 41-bet — noto'g'ri fe'llar, moda va yutuq lug'ati, 'although'.

groups.ruleUz: ALTHOUGH va BUT — ikkalasi ham qarama-qarshilik

items.base: ALTHOUGH she was beautiful, she didn't marry.
She was beautiful BUT she didn't marry.
items.baseUz: U go'zal edi, lekin turmushga chiqmadi.

patterns.formula: DID + ism + ASOSIY fe'l ...?  →  No, he DIDN'T. + boshqa ism + O'TGAN fe'l ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Did Pele star in Top Gun? — No, he didn't. Tom Cruise starred in Top Gun.
patterns.exampleUz: Pele 'Top Gun' da o'ynaganmi? — Yo'q. 'Top Gun' da Tom Kruz o'ynagan.
patterns.explanationUz: Savolda ASOSIY shakl, javobda O'TGAN shakl.

patterns.formula: Ega + WAS BORN IN + joy, IN + yil.
patterns.exampleEn: Coco Chanel was born in Saumur, in France, in 1883.
patterns.exampleUz: Koko Shanel 1883-yilda Fransiyaning Somyur shahrida tug'ilgan.

patterns.formula: ALTHOUGH + gap, + ega + DIDN'T + ASOSIY fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Although Chanel was a beautiful woman, she didn't marry.
patterns.exampleUz: Shanel go'zal ayol bo'lsa-da, turmushga chiqmadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'although' gap BOSHIDA, o'rtaga VERGUL.
'didn't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl.

patterns.formula: WHEN WAS + ega + BORN?   ↔   WHEN DID + ega + DIE?
patterns.exampleEn: When was Coco Chanel born? When did Coco Chanel die?
patterns.exampleUz: Koko Shanel qachon tug'ilgan? Koko Shanel qachon vafot etgan?

patterns.formula: Ega + USUALLY + present simple, BUT + vaqt + past simple.
patterns.exampleEn: Jane usually walks to school, but yesterday she went by bus.
patterns.exampleUz: Jeyn odatda maktabga piyoda boradi, lekin kecha avtobusda bordi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'usually' → present simple;  'yesterday/last ...' → past simple.
'but' ikkisini bog'laydi.

patterns.exampleEn: She quickly added sweaters, skirts and accessories to her collection.
patterns.exampleUz: U tezda kolleksiyasiga sviter, yubka va aksessuarlar qo'shdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'add something TO something' — 'to' SHART.
'quickly' — ravish, fe'ldan oldin.
